name: Rooster's Country Café
tagline: Homemade Southern food and a bit of traditional Mexican on Business 83.
about: Rooster's Country Café at 14362 W Business 83 in Harlingen serves homemade Southern food with a bit of traditional Mexican cooking, plus breakfast all day.
Local press describes grandma-style recipes and big portions. Yelp reviewers praise the food, service and prices, and one calls it a hidden gem of the Valley.
hours_source: Hours as listed on Facebook; call ahead to confirm.
sources: Menu: Toast; reviews: Yelp via MapQuest
conflicts: A 2023 article listed 6 a.m. to 8 p.m. daily.
